info.name: OneCLI Agent Setup Partner Members API

items.docs: Returns the people who can sign in to your partner portal. Requires a Partner API key (`oc_partner_…`) or a partner portal session.

Adds a member to your partner by email; they sign in to the portal with that email. Only owners and admins can add members. The assignable roles are `admin` and `member` — the owner role is set at partner creation and can't be granted.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of a partner member (the user).

items.docs: Moves a member between `admin` and `member`. Only owners and admins can do this, and the owner's role can't be changed.

params.name: userId
params.description: ID of a partner member (the user).

items.docs: Removes a member from your partner. Only owners and admins can do this, and the owner can't be removed.
